text: Welcome to the bead atelier. Pick a necklace to make!
Make a two-bead pattern: one, two, one, two.
Make a three-bead pattern: one, two, three, then repeat.
Make your very own necklace. Any beads you like!
Follow the two-bead pattern. Thread the glowing spot next.
Follow the three-bead pattern. Thread the glowing spot next.
Choose any bead. Start at the left and make it yours.
Through the hole, then slide it home!
Bring the bead to the glowing spot.
Round, barrel, round, barrel. Find the round bead.
Round, barrel, round, barrel. Find the barrel bead.
Round, barrel, diamond. What comes next?
Find the round bead.
Find the barrel bead.
Find the diamond bead.
Find the flower bead.
Find the star bead.
Find the heart bead.
You followed the pattern. What a beautiful necklace!
